crossRefs.note: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it, and by everything on it.

translations.web: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it, and by everything on it.
translations.bsb: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
translations.kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
translations.asv: He therefore that sweareth by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
